question: In the second after a base move that makes a pull request conflict, does a REST read of it still give `mergeable` true? (P-40's question, when only the base branch moves, asked of the first second: the first run read the conflicting pull request a second after the other.)
pass: Written before the run, in a comment on issue 809 at 2026-11-13T05:12:07Z, after the first run (trials/P-40.json): one base branch and one pull request B to it, made for the trial in the canary. B is read until mergeable is true. One push moves the base so that B conflicts. Then B is read by REST six times in a row with no wait between, the first as soon as the push's answer is back; then once by GraphQL; then by REST and GraphQL at 15, 30, 45 and 60 seconds. Pass if no read of B after the push gives mergeable true, unknown being allowed, and B reads false within the 60 seconds. Fail if any read of B after the push gives true, or B is still unknown at 60 seconds. A pass would show only that this run caught no stale true, not that none can be given. Apps installed on the canary commented on the pull request during the run and one of them edited its description; no head was pushed to, and what else was written is counted in each read's `comments`. Nothing of that came between the last read before the move and the first worked-out read after it: `updated_at` and `comments` are the same from one to the other.
